احتفلتن (form VIII)
# اِحْتَفَلْتُنَّ (iḥtafaltunna) /iħ.ta.fal.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِحْتَفَلَ (iḥtafala)
# اُحْتُفِلْتُنَّ (uḥtufiltunna) /uħ.tu.fil.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِحْتَفَلَ (iḥtafala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
